note: School cursive models (прописи); points run in writing direction, y absolute on the 132-pt strip, x from the letter's origin; entry/exit are where joins arrive and leave.

и.hint: и starts at the top: down, cup, up, then down and cup again. (л and м start with a hook on the line.)

й.hint: й is и with a little cup above it, added after the letter.

ш.hint: ш is three cups in one stroke, rounded at the bottom; т is rounded at the top.

щ.hint: щ is ш with a small tail below the line at the end.

ц.hint: ц is и with a small tail below the line at the end.

л.hint: л starts with a little hook on the baseline, climbs to the top, then comes down into its cup.

strokes.name: hook, up, down, up, down, cup

м.hint: м starts with the hook on the baseline, climbs, dips to the line and climbs again; и has no hook.

т.hint: т is three humps in one stroke, rounded at the top (ш is rounded at the bottom).

п.hint: п: down, back up the same line, over the hump, then down into the cup.

strokes.name: down, up to the middle, loop, bar, up, down, cup

н.hint: н: down, back up to the middle, a tiny loop, the bar across, up to the top and down into the cup.

г.hint: г curls over at the top, then one stem down into the cup.

ч.hint: ч: a shallow bowl from the top to the middle, up to the top, then down into the cup.

strokes.name: down, up to the middle, arm, leg

к.hint: к: down, back up to the middle, a short arm up, then the leg down into its cup.

р.hint: р: the stem goes below the line, back up to the top, then the bowl round to the right.

у.hint: у: down, cup, up, then the long stroke below the line with a loop to the left.

о.hint: о starts near the top right and goes round anticlockwise, closing where it began.

а.hint: а is an oval round anticlockwise, then a stem down its right side into the cup.

д.hint: д is an oval whose stem drops below the line and loops back to the left (not the print д with feet).

б.hint: б is an oval, then its stem climbs above the small letters and flags to the right.

в.hint: в climbs to a loop above the small letters, drops down the stem, and closes its bowl at the top.

е.hint: е rises from the line, loops over the top and round, and leaves at the bottom right.

ё.hint: ё is е with two dots above, added after the letter.

с.hint: с starts at the top right and goes round anticlockwise, leaving at the bottom right.

э.hint: э goes round clockwise from the top left; the bar across the middle comes second.

з.hint: з: a small bump at the top, in to the waist, then a bigger curve that loops below the line.

strokes.name: left half, up, stem, up, right half

ж.hint: ж: the left half-oval like с, up to the stem, down it, up again and the right half-oval the other way.

х.hint: х is two curves back to back, touching in the middle: the left one first (bulging right), then the right one.

ф.hint: ф: the left oval, the long stem down below the line, then the right oval.

ы.hint: ы: down, a small bowl back to the stem, then up to the top and down into the cup.

ь.hint: ь: one stem down, then a small bowl that closes on the stem halfway up.

ъ.hint: ъ is ь with a little flag at the top that the stem hangs from.

strokes.name: down, up to the middle, bar, oval

ю.hint: ю: down, back up to the middle, the short bar, then the oval round from its left side.

я.hint: я starts with the hook, climbs, loops its head to the left down to the middle, then the stem into the cup.

А.hint: А starts with a hook on the line, climbs to the top and comes down into the cup; the bar comes last.

Б.hint: Б: the stem down, a bowl from its foot back to the middle, then the roof to the right.

В.hint: В: the stem down, then two bowls off it, the lower one a little bigger.

Г.hint: Г: the roof from right to left, round the corner and down the stem into the cup.

Д.hint: Д: down to the left, a loop at the foot, along the line and round up over the top.

Е.hint: Е is two rounds open to the right, the top one first, both anticlockwise.

Ё.hint: Ё is Е with two dots above.

strokes.name: left half, up, stem, up, right half

Ж.hint: Ж: the left half-oval like С, up to the stem, down it, up again and the right half-oval the other way.

З.hint: З is two rounds to the right, clockwise, the lower one a little bigger.

И.hint: И: down, cup, up, then down and cup again — the same as the small и, taller.

Й.hint: Й is И with a little cup above.

К.hint: К: the stem down into its cup, then the arm from the top right to a little loop in the middle and the leg out.

Л.hint: Л starts with a hook on the line, climbs to the top and comes down into the cup.

strokes.name: hook, up, down, up, down, cup

М.hint: М starts with the hook, climbs, dips to the line and climbs again, then down into the cup.

Н.hint: Н: the left stem; then from its middle a tiny loop, the bar across, up to the top and down into the cup.

О.hint: О goes round anticlockwise from the top right, closing where it began.

П.hint: П: the left stem down, then the roof across and the right stem down into its cup.

Р.hint: Р: the stem down into its cup, then the bowl off the top.

С.hint: С starts at the top right and goes round anticlockwise.

Т.hint: Т: the wavy roof first, then the stem down the middle into its cup.

У.hint: У: a short curve from the top left down to the middle, up to the top right, then the long stroke down to a curl on the line.

Ф.hint: Ф: the left oval, the stem down the middle, then the right oval.

Х.hint: Х is two curves back to back, touching in the middle: the left one first, then the right.

Ц.hint: Ц is И with a small tail below the line at the end.

Ч.hint: Ч: a bowl from the top down to the middle, up to the top right, then down into the cup.

Ш.hint: Ш is three cups in one stroke, rounded at the bottom.

Щ.hint: Щ is Ш with a small tail below the line at the end.

Ъ.hint: Ъ: the flag along the top, the stem down from its end, then the bowl back to the middle.

Ы.hint: Ы: the stem down, a bowl back to the middle, then up to the top and down into the cup.

Ь.hint: Ь: the stem down, then the bowl from its foot back to the middle.

Э.hint: Э goes round clockwise from the top left; the bar comes second.

Ю.hint: Ю: the stem down, back up to the middle, the bar, then the oval round from its left side.

Я.hint: Я starts with the hook, climbs, loops its head to the left down to the middle, then the stem into the cup.
